background: Finnish coach (born Jan 1982) who rose through Europe: Tapiolan Honka (Finland), Crailsheim Merlins (Germany, 2016-21, promoted from ProA and reached 5th in the BBL), Telekom Baskets Bonn (2021-23; BBL Coach of the Year 2022, Basketball Champions League title and Best Coach 2023, BBL finals 2023), and Paris Basketball (2023-24; EuroCup champion, French Leaders Cup, record 98.4 ppg in EuroCup). Joined Taylor Jenkins' Memphis staff as an offense-focused assistant in 2024-25, was named interim head coach when Jenkins was fired with nine games left (went 4-5, won the play-in to the 8 seed, swept 0-4 by OKC), then permanent head coach in May 2025. His first full season (2025-26) was a 25-57 teardown marked by a public feud with Ja Morant over his short-stint substitution patterns, clutch-execution criticism and 'Fire Iisalo' chants; Morant was traded to Portland in June 2026 and Jaren Jackson Jr. to Utah. The rebuilt 2026-27 team around No. 1 pick Cameron Boozer opened 6-0, tying the franchise's best start.
